post_topic: Showing Signal product positioning — built for buyer's agents, not retrofitted
image_description:
Single standalone diagram. One concept only. No panels, no grids, no collages. Full bleed 1080x1080px white background.

Title at top center in bold navy text: "Built for Buyer Agents — Not Retrofitted"

Diagram is divided into two vertical columns separated by a thin vertical dividing line. Left column header: "Generic CRM" in muted gray. Right column header: "Showing Signal" in blue #5a96ff.

Left column shows a downward flow of three boxes in gray: Box 1 labeled "Listing-Centric Data Model" → Box 2 labeled "Buyer Fields Bolted On" → Box 3 labeled "Workarounds Required". Each box connected by a downward arrow. A small amber callout label floats beside Box 2 reading "Retrofitted".

Right column shows a downward flow of three boxes in navy #0A0F1E with blue borders: Box 1 labeled "Showings Booked" → Box 2 labeled "Feedback Collected" → Box 3 labeled "Deal Progression Tracked". Each box connected by a downward arrow in blue #5a96ff. A small amber #F5A623 callout label floats beside Box 1 reading "Native Object".

Below both columns, a single centered row of three tier badges in navy with amber text labels: Badge 1 "Solo Agent" | Badge 2 "Independent Team" | Badge 3 "Brokerage". Badges connected by thin horizontal lines to indicate a tiered structure.

Below the tier badges, a single centered callout box in amber #F5A623 with navy text reading: "14-Day Money-Back Guarantee · No Sales Call Required"

Navy #0A0F1E primary elements, blue #5a96ff highlights, amber #F5A623 callouts and important labels. Clean sans-serif font. Real cloud provider logos where relevant. Small text "Kelvin Davis" bottom right corner. Professional LinkedIn infographic style similar to ByteByteGo. White background. No dark backgrounds.
